locate.en: On ECOS (ecos.bok.or.kr), open 통계검색 (Statistics search) and type the table name “수출금액지수” or its code 403Y001 in the search box, or follow the statistics list 3. 환율/통관수출입/외환보유액 > 3.3. 무역지수/교역조건지수(2020=100) > 3.3.1. 수출입 금액/물량지수 > 3.3.1.1. 수출 금액/물량지수 > 3.3.1.1.1. 수출금액지수. In the table, select 계정코드: 반도체. Set the cycle (주기) to monthly, choose the period, and click 조회 (Search).
